{{Top}}
[[File:Robolobotomy.png|thumb|right|250px|A robolobotomized [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] reveals information.]]
{{Quote|Maybe this tactical droid will tell us how they knew our plan.|[[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]], preparing to perform a robolobotomy on TJ-55's captured cranial unit|<ref name="The Hidden Enemy">{{TCW|The Hidden Enemy}}</ref>}}
A '''robolobotomy''' was a procedure performed on droids to extract data from their [[Droid brain/Legends|droid brain]].

==History==
{{Quote|We did a robolobotomy on the battle droids and came up with this piece of memory.|[[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]], accessing a holorecording of Dr. Nuvo Vindi|<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus (episode)">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref>}}
Robolobotomy was used on the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[TJ-55/Legends|TJ-55]] on [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] to gather more information about stolen intelligence, but was unsuccessful. Robolobotomy was used by [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]] on a [[Unidentified T-series tactical droid (Aayla Secura's ambush)|tactical droid]] after a [[Battle for the Galactic Republic information bunker|battle]]. [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] also used one on a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] to gain information on [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Nuvo Vindi]] and his [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] [[Viral bomb/Legends|bombs]].
